name: Stripe
line: Card and wallet payments with hosted checkout and payment links.

cells.countries: 44 countries, incl. US, UK and Germany; India preview
cells.payout: US 2 business days; UK, DE 7 days first

fee.math: This is the standard rate for online payments by a US seller.
For a UK seller, premium UK cards cost 2.8% plus £0.20.
For a euro seller in Germany, premium EEA cards cost 2.8% plus €0.25.
The published rate for Visa or Mastercard cards issued in India. For domestic debit cards, the merchant discount rate (MDR) is 0.4%, capped at INR200. New accounts are invite-only.
